title: 16 Days Premium Tour in Western Canada and Vancouver Island
includes: Admission to Ice Explorer Glacier Tour
Admission to Squamish Lil’Wat Cultural Centre
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Explore the stunning landscapes of Western Canada on this 16-day premium tour that encompasses the Canadian Rockies, vibrant towns, and the serene beauty of Vancouver Island. Visit iconic destinations such as Whistler, Jasper, Banff, Kelowna, and Victoria. An experienced guide will share insights into the rich history and culture of the region, ensuring a memorable adventure filled with both guided tours and free time for personal exploration.

- Duration: 16 days with 15 nights accommodation.
- Maximum group size: 23, ensuring a personalized experience.
- Daily breakfast included, along with selected guided tours and activities.
- Enjoy exclusive entry to attractions such as the Ice Explorer Glacier Adventure and The Butchart Gardens.
